scope: Contextual modeling workspace backed by the canonical native design; bounded integration, not complete Fusion parity.

validation.command: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build

validation.result: 6 passed; analytic geometry, constraints, dragging, cold reopen, associative projection/detach, multibody history, unit equations and cycle refusal

validation.command: cd frontend && PYTHONPATH=<worktree>/src O3D_ENGINE_BINARY=<native-engine> O3D_TEST_PORT=8964 npx playwright test --config tests/modeling/playwright.config.ts
validation.result: 5 passed in 10.6 seconds on disposable Store/Vite ports 8964/5194; actual native transaction routes, no engine mocks

rows.implemented: SVG placement of points, lines, rectangles, rounded rectangles, circles, arcs and fit splines; native solved entities, stable profile selectors and sketch reuse for feature forms.
rows.remaining: Spline canvas currently shows a labeled fit/control polygon, not an evaluated spline. Full region hit-testing and broad face-attached sketch cases need acceptance.

rows.implemented: Driving/reference dimension commands, geometric constraints, AutoConstrain, actual DOF/failure IDs, glyph inspection, constrained dragging, constraint deletion and driven toggles.
rows.remaining: Full constraint-proposal UX and all rounded-profile conflict recovery cases are unaccepted.

rows.implemented: Canvas trim/extend/break; engine-computed trim-path dry-run preview; offset, fillet, pattern, mirror, construction and move/copy forms.
rows.remaining: Full mixed-curve offset/trim/pattern and undo corpus has not passed product acceptance.

rows.implemented: Associative project/intersect/include forms, source sketch references, linked/lost-link status and explicit detach/reproject repair controls. Projection update and solved-geometry detach regression pass with the core materialization fix.
rows.remaining: Atomic source relinking preserving derived curve identities is unavailable; the full lost/split/ambiguous reference corpus remains.

rows.implemented: 3D-sketch mode toggle, native 3D polyline/spline input and sweep/pipe path forms.
rows.remaining: No graphical three-dimensional point manipulator or accepted nonplanar path/frame editing workflow.

rows.implemented: Bundled-font sketch text, PNG/JPEG reference-image insertion and native calibration; browser acceptance verifies image scale and text curve identities after cold reload. SVG/DXF exchange is owned by interop.
rows.remaining: Text emboss/extrusion and broad image/sketch interchange acceptance are pending. Images are limited to 512 KiB by the command envelope. External font paths are unavailable.

rows.implemented: Offset, angled and midplane, cylinder-axis and two-point-axis forms using actual construction commands; construction planes offered for sketches.
rows.remaining: Broad dependent construction/reference workflows and coordinate-system equivalence are unaccepted. Advanced construction commands are in the interop panel.

rows.implemented: Extrude including profile indices, direction, second side and taper; box/cylinder/sphere/torus with new/join/cut/intersect/auto semantics.
rows.remaining: Thin extrusion and from/to-object dialogs and the full Boolean/taper corpus need further integration.

rows.implemented: Native revolve, sweep with twist/orientation, and loft with ordered sections and guide rails.
rows.remaining: Graphical axis/path/rail selection and full nonplanar/self-intersection acceptance are incomplete.

rows.implemented: Simple/drilled/counterbore/countersink hole forms and cosmetic/modeled native thread options, selectable face point population.
rows.remaining: Full thread designation, angled drilling and feature edit/reopen corpus is unaccepted.

rows.implemented: Native topology edge picking, constant/curvature/variable/chord fillet and chamfer forms with real refusal/fit behavior.
rows.remaining: Spline-radius controls, corner blends and all persistent edge-reference cases are unaccepted.

rows.implemented: Shell, draft and pipe forms with native parameter expressions.
rows.remaining: Dedicated rib/web/coil controls and a measured thin-wall corpus remain.

rows.implemented: Rectangular/circular patterns, mirror and body move/copy/scale forms; sketch patterns.
rows.remaining: Path patterns, instance suppression and full feature/component pattern selection remain.

rows.implemented: Multiple native bodies, native body/topology browser, individual measurements, combine and split-body forms; measured two-body history test.
rows.remaining: Interactive boundary-fill cell selection and the full Boolean robustness corpus are unavailable/unaccepted.

rows.implemented: No plastic-feature UI is claimed by this track.
rows.remaining: Boss, snap-fit, lip/rest and editable generated connection workflows.

rows.implemented: Press/pull, face offset, delete/heal, shell and body transforms use real native face/body operations and timeline persistence.
rows.remaining: Base-feature/history-free mode and graphical replace-face controls are incomplete.

rows.implemented: Canonical surface document support is shared core work; advanced surface forms are owned by the interop panel.
rows.remaining: See interop acceptance for create/continuity/thicken. No complete surface parity is claimed here.

rows.implemented: Surface repair controls and tolerance reporting are delegated to the interop implementation.
rows.remaining: See interop evidence; surface-fillet parity is not inferred from other repair commands.

rows.implemented: No T-spline sculpting UI or conversion workflow is claimed.
rows.remaining: Control-cage editor, subdivision/bridge/crease, self-intersection checks and B-rep conversion.

rows.implemented: Mesh asset insertion and bounded reconstruction are owned by interop; native mesh representation belongs to core.
rows.remaining: See interop tests; broad scan reconstruction is not claimed.

rows.implemented: No broad mesh-authoring/repair toolset is claimed by the modeling panel.
rows.remaining: Face-group edits, reduction/remeshing, hole/normal/nonmanifold repair, plane cut and shell/combine acceptance.

rows.implemented: Native equation/unit parameters, model/user filtering, rename/change/delete, dependency inspection/graph, CSV/JSON import and CSV export; measured inch/mm equation and cycle rejection tests.

rows.implemented: Native timeline inspection/editing, rename, suppress, reorder, roll-after/end, grouping, dependents and first actual feature errors.
rows.remaining: Graphical drag reorder, folder/marker manipulation and the full dependency/rollback repair corpus remain.

rows.implemented: Sketch entity multi-select/drag and profile selection; native face/edge filter/browser and certified topology metadata; selections persist in shared native context.
